integrity: All analytical bounds include their order restrictions and equality cases; all companion computations use exact arithmetic and are finite corroboration, not an all-order certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exactly fair independent bond percolation on finite fixed simple trees; no assertions for other probabilities or non-tree hosts; equality by degree multiset, not a complete graph-isomorphism census. Historical priority against all degree-index literature remains uncertain.
title: Sharp fair-percolation isolation–edge covariance bounds on trees and their degree-five extremizers
